text:
alice: Canary p95 up ~22% vs baseline for v3.5.2 in eu-west-1. DeployBot paused rollout. Requesting rollback decision.
deploybot: [Automated] Rollout paused for v3.5.2 - 'p95_latency' threshold breached (1.6x baseline). Details: https://deploy.redwood/rollouts/6234. Suggested actions: manual rollback or isolate canary traffic. Autorevert disabled for dedicated pools.
ben: Which endpoints are affected? embeddings or generation?
alice: generation endpoints only. Observed KV cache miss spike + GC flurry in the runtime logs. Affected traffic ~8% of canary slice.
carla: +1 to rollback to v3.5.1. I'll take exec. Need release notes update and a short customer blurb drafted.
ben: Plan: `tools/deploy rollback --service inference-api --to-tag v3.5.1 --regions eu-west-1,us-west-2 --reason "canary-p95-regression"` I'll run in 5m unless objections.
paul: Support looped in, PM notified in #product. Release-notes diff draft: https://confluence.redwood/rdw/release-notes/v3.5.1-v3.5.2 (editing).
alice: :thumbsup: go ahead. Ben, after rollback please post a short status in #customer-communications.
deploybot: [Action] Rollback started by ben. Job id: jb-98765. Rolling back inference-api -> v3.5.1 in eu-west-1, us-west-2. ETA ~4m.
deploybot: [Result] Rollback completed. Traffic reverted to v3.5.1 in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. p95 latency back to baseline. Marking incident resolved. :white_check_mark:
ben: Confirmed p95 back to normal, logs show KV cache behavior stabilized. Creating follow-up ticket for KV cache investigation: TICKET-5473.
carla: I'll draft the customer-facing blurb and post in #customer-communications. Reminder: include rollback reason, impact, and next steps/mitigation.
